name: Doraemon
commentsPratyush: Watched it as a child - it was vibes.
commentsKanav: I barely remember this story

name: One Piece
length: 1122 manga chapters, 1114 anime episodes (ongoing - both); I have only watched the Live Action
commentsPratyush: This is a long journey I need to get to eventually. So far, I've only watched the live action - and its actually pretty good.

name: swordmaster’s youngest son
commentsPratyush: Magic-swordsman power fanstasy with clear power scaling and likable characters. I really enjoyed the start of the story, but towards the end I started feeling lost as to where the story was headed, who is the villain, and when it would wrap up.

name: Ben 10
commentsPratyush: Its crazy to think how many universes with amazing power scaling lose to Ben 10 (low diff win). Inetersting concept + I enjoyed watching it when I was <10 years.

name: Damn Reincarnation
commentsPratyush: The novel is hillarious. It starts off well, and then I got worried it wouldn't be able to transition and wrap up - but it managed to tie the end of the story in a fun way. Some weird arcs and irritating characters at time, but overall fun.

name: Legend of Zelda
length: 20+ games; I've followed the lore for 2
commentsPratyush: Love BOTW and TOTK. Beautiful games that got me invested into the Zelda lore. Link is him.

name: Lego Ninjago
commentsPratyush: This felt so cool as a child, and it has some of my favorite scenes ever - "You ruined my life" "How could I ruin your life when I wasn't even there?" (absentee father)

name: Studio Ghibli
commentsPratyush: Vibes.

name: Rick & Morty
commentsPratyush: One of my friends told me that this show messed him up as a child. I understand that now. I didn't know crazy until I watched this show. That being said - still fun.
favoriteCharacters: Space Beth is the one I hate the least

name: Impact Winter
commentsPratyush: Vampires, but its better than twilight. Like much better. And the two female leads are actually well written.

name: Sakamoto Days
commentsPratyush: John Wick (but happy) meets anime + elements of slice of life and comedy. Its a lot of fun.

name: Eminence in Shadow
commentsPratyush: A comedy filled with meta jokes about anime tropes. Wouldn't recommend to a first time anime watcher, but if you're deep in the community, this is hillarious. A little but like One Punch Man - don't take the show seriously, you're just there for a laugh.

name: Horimiya
commentsPratyush: Cute slice of life and romance. Lots of memes.

name: Superhuman Battlefield
commentsPratyush: A good well rounded story about super humans and an other-worldly invasion. In the world after the invasion, these super humans turn into athletes that play in global team v/s team competitive leagues.

name: I want to eat your pancreas
length: 1 movie, I didn't read the comic
commentsPratyush: Don't go off of the name - this is a great movie. The name will make sense when you watch it. You might even tear up.

name: Suzume
commentsPratyush: First anime movie I watched in the theather with friends. Great animation and sound, meh story, but I'll remember it fondly due to the experience.

name: A silent voice
commentsPratyush: Touching slice of life movie about growing up, and growing out of the walls we built around ourselves as children when we were dumb and made some mistakes we regret.

name: Weathering with you
commentsPratyush: Its a good movie, but kind of like Your Name, I think animation and sound design hard carry. Not that the story is bad, but you wouldn't have people hyping it up as much if it weren't such a visual spectacle.

name: I Got a New Skill Every Time I Was Exiled, and After 100 Different Worlds, I Was Unmatched
commentsPratyush: VERY Honest name. That being said, interesting gimmick and story telling so far. It is A rank because it has a lot of promise, but lets see how it unfolds.

name: Pokemon
commentsPratyush: Why is Ash still a child? How many more remakes and new regions?
favoriteCharacters: Bulbasaur with sunglasses playing a trumpet

name: Ninja Hatori
genre: Comedy, Slice of Life, Martial Arts
commentsPratyush: Peak hindi-dub childhood show. Growing up is realizing Amara was never the villain and Keneji needed to lock in.

name: Star Wars
length: Skywalker Saga = 9 films, I don't know how long the full cannon is
commentsPratyush: I should come back to this. This was my favorite Angry Birds collab game by far.

name: Wind Breaker
commentsPratyush: Beautiful animation, but its just highschoolers throwing hands. Refreshing to see an action story without crazy powerscaling (unlike some other stories that pretend to be human but are basically supers). A fun light watch.

name: Transformers
length: Full franchise — too broad; live-action films = 7

name: Hell's Paradise
commentsPratyush: It has its weird parts, but its still a good watch. The story is based on a mix of history, popular fictional tropes, and fantasy inserts - so you might see the twists coming a mile away, but the execution isn't bad.

name: The Live
commentsPratyush: One of the oldest manhwas on this list - it was a very interesting story when it came out. No over the top power scaling, crazy visuals, fight choreographies, or aura farming - just a good set of characters trying their best to survive and get back home.

name: Trash of the Count's Family
commentsPratyush: Lol, what a cheesy scammer.

name: The Water Magician
commentsPratyush: Straight forward and fun. This guy has water magic, and he uses it to fight monsters and bad guys. Very creative - people in the avatar world should've tried these water bending techniques.

name: The Novel’s Extra
commentsPratyush: Interesting but not entirely original concept - you become an extra in a novel you wrote yourself (kinda like ORV). So far so good. Evangel (the adopted daughter of the protagonist) is really cute.

name: Player Who Returned 10,000 years later
commentsPratyush: Demon King is just a dude, and he returns from the Demon Realm and tries to fit in with the humans, and then tries really hard to frame literally anyone else as the final villain. He also really likes Kimchi stew.

name: Return of the 8th class magician
commentsPratyush: Another really old manhwa on here - genius magicial gets manipulated by bad folks, turns back time, and switches teams. This was one of the stories that introduced me to the magic circles and mana mechanisms for magic in the korean comic world.

name: Your name
commentsPratyush: Really hot take - this movie isn't a master piece. I know the animation and sound design is awesome, but I'm just not as blown away by the story. Its still good, but I personally think its overhyped.

name: Power Rangers
commentsPratyush: vibes as a kid, but I out grew this fast

name: Digimon
commentsPratyush: Pokemon, but edgy. Your friends would know you're a cool kid and not a normie when you talked about Digimon at the age of 10.

name: I Funny
commentsPratyush: I don't remember this too well.

name: Book Eater
commentsPratyush: Man gets a tome called gluttony - and then eats books and learns the magic in them. Very straight forward.

name: Mashle: Magic & Muscle
length: 162 chapters in manga, S1 Anime has 12 episodes
commentsPratyush: Harry Potter but with creatine and protien powder.

name: Legendary Son of the Marquis House
commentsPratyush: I think I liked it when I read it many years ago, but don't remember a lot anymore.

name: Shadowless night
commentsPratyush: Cute socially awkward protagonist, great art, but not much of a story.

name: Warrior High School
commentsPratyush: I enjoyed reading it in the start, but then it went on hiatus and never returned.

name: The Challenger
commentsPratyush: Another VR video game story, but with a new cool mechanic - sync rate. This measures how much you're able to overcome ping/lag in your brain and get completely synchronized with the video game. Also has much better analysis of how different gamers get good with different strategies.

name: Beyblade
commentsPratyush: This anime confuses me looking back, but it was definitely hype to first play with the toys

name: Chota Bheem
commentsPratyush: I think its a bad story. Terrible portrayal of Indian villages, teaches kids to fat shame and bully each other, promotes an unhealthy diet, and its like a 6 year old's power fantasy. The movies redeem the franchise a lot though.

name: Regressor instruction manual
commentsPratyush: Interesting concept where the protagonist isn't a regressor, but rather figures out who the regressor is and tries to get carried - but soon devolves into a disgustingly manipulative story. Sometimes I was just rooting for more bad things to happen to this guy coz he sucks, but he has the tenacity of a cockroach. I dropped this one.

name: My School Life Pretending To Be a Worthless Person
commentsPratyush: Meh. Too edgy for my taste with this guy's mental issues and ass-pull powerups.

name: Baki
commentsPratyush: Dude what even is this show. Do not watch with active braincells. I'm not saying its not entertaining - but if you try to make sense of it, that's already wrong.

name: Cowboy Bebop
commentsPratyush: If you like Bladerunner and futuristic sci-fi, this is down your alley. This show is like a dream that you'll be jarred to wake up from, and you'll carry it with you.

name: Disney
favoriteCharacters: Merida (from Brave) and Flynn Ryder (from Tangled)

name: Death is the only ending for the villainess
commentsPratyush: This is not a story I'd expect to be down my alley - a girl magically transmigrates into a medieval europe dating sim where she needs to get a proposal from one of the male leads to finish the game. It sounds really stupid and I thought I'd drop it - but surprisingly its a really good story about how female strength and struggle look very different from male strength and struggle. Bridgerton fans, get a load of this.

name: Sherlock Holmes
length: 13 episodes of Sherlock, 2 RDJ movies, numerous comics + the actual books
commentsPratyush: This created the genre of detective fiction. Its honestly peak - the only issue is, its unclear what I'm referring to here. Still, I like almost all Sherlock content - and I'd recommend Benedict Cumberbatch's show off the top of my mind.

name: Invincible
commentsPratyush: This man has really been beaten senseless so many times that I can't bring myself to call him out on plot armor anymore. I enjoyed the comics, but I think the story in the show is a huge step up - though the animation is inconsistent. Cmon Amazon, money clearly isn't the issue here.

name: Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood
commentsPratyush: Beautiful well rounded story. I see why its a contender for 'best anime ever' despite all of the new gen anime having better animation and sound design. Love the world building, plot progression and inter-twining of all the arcs. My favorite part of this story is - there are almost no 'side characters'. Every character feels like a living-thinking-feeling human being having their own motivations and making their own decisions. No character introduced goes to waste, and everyone plays a part (the total opposite of Solo Leveling).
favoriteCharacters: Roy Mustang (ik, how basic of me)

name: Six of Crows
commentsPratyush: Book 1 is one of my favorite hiest stories. Book 2 wraps up the plot and connects to the broader fictional universe.

name: Alice in Borderland
commentsPratyush: Its a gamified apolocalytpic world. Given my ranking of ORV, you know I love stories like this. Fun to discuss with your friends how you would deal with and try to survive the different games. For APDA people - Daniel Katari has a really fun debate case on this too.

name: Arcane
commentsPratyush: Just because you love Arcane doesn't mean you need to start playing League - every league player I know. Its a beautiful 2 season show with a unique art style, a rich cast of characters, and an interesting magic-meets-steampunk power system. Would recommending watching; I don't play league so can't comment on what to do after the show is over.
favoriteCharacters: (to my great surprise) Silco, and Mel

name: Frieren
commentsPratyush: This is my current favorite feel good show. Its like therapy after all the 2nd hand trauma from the many other stories I've read/watched. I also study to the sound tracks from this show (10/10 would recommend)

name: Violet Evergarden
commentsPratyush: This story is so beautiful, it actually made me cry. Its about a child soldier recovering from their PTSD and trying to readjust in the post-war world.

name: Odd Taxi
commentsPratyush: This is a slept on masterpiece. Unique art style, great usage of characters for plot progression, and a twist you won't see coming. 10/10 would recommend.

name: Cyberpunk Edgerunners
commentsPratyush: High octane sci-fi thriller with amazing visuals and plot progression. I loved this series when I watched it, but just a headsup - this is still Night City. "A happier ending? For folks like us? Wrong city, wrong people."

name: Stormlight Archive
commentsPratyush: Lots of depression, and the story takes time to get to a roll, but the ending of each book has been really hype so far. Finishing the series rn.
favoriteCharacters: Rock and Lopen (The one armed herdazian)

name: DC
length: new: 2 films + 2 seasons (15 eps); but many more movies, shows and comics
commentsPratyush: I love DC Comics. Cinematic Universe not as much. The Batman animated shows >>> Marvel.
commentsKanav: Lego Batman was peak, I have not watched much of DC however
favoriteCharacters: Lego Batman, Plastic Man, John Constantine

name: Marvel Cinematic Universe
length: 38 films; 17 series (21 seasons), and more comics than I want to count
commentsPratyush: While DC wins in comics, Marvel curbstomps in movies.
commentsKanav: Marvel films are fun, though it kind of died after endgame

name: Regressed Mercenary’s Machinations
commentsPratyush: I enjoyed both the manhwa and the novel. The manhwa is really fast paced and glosses over many arcs and character development. The novel is entertaining, but feels like there are filler arcs in the middle. The protagonist starts cruising at some point, so there are no real stakes and you're just vibing along the journey until they defeat the big bad. The villain is a little too mysterious for you to think there are any real risks or stakes. I enjoyed it until the weird time-travel stuff with the first tower of magic and first hero - then I dropped it.
commentsKanav: Amazing fight coreography, that drew me in at the start, I have only read the manhwa and it is a regression story but the protagonist faces real chalenges even though he knows what is to come

name: Solo leveling
length: 270 novel, 200 comic chapters, 68 sequel comic chapters (ongoing), anime 2 seasons (ongoing)
commentsPratyush: Is it a good story? Idk. I barely remember the names of most of the side characters, and every arc is fundamentally the same + rips off a lot of Hunter x Hunter. Its a feel-good power fantasy where there's little to no character development, and just straight wins for the protagonist. But does Sung Jin Woo have aura? You bet he does. This story + art definitely delivers on the hype.
commentsKanav: It is very honest in its name, apart from the protagonist there is basicaly nobody on the supporting side that is strong/iconic/remembrable. Its just one fight after another which was very fun to read. (I count the shadow soldiers as extensions of the protagonist)

name: Spy x Family
commentsPratyush: I wish this came out when I was in primary or middle school. Can be slightly cringe at times, but in an adorable way. Its one of my go-to comfort shows right now.
commentsKanav: Very nice family friendly show, it was a bit cringe for me

name: The Alchemist
commentsPratyush: Great book. I read this on my flight to college for the first time.

name: Nano Machine
commentsPratyush: Really interesting concept - taking futuristic nano machines and giving them to a martial artist back in history to see how the course of history changes. Unfortunately, the character progression tanks as the story progresses, and the manhwa kept a part of the novel that I really didn't like - so that drops the rating in my eyes.

name: Academy's Undercover Professor
commentsPratyush: Started out great - kinda Harry Potter-esque, but the protagonist is impersonating a professor at the magic school. Soon devolves into a lot of things happening all at once, but lets see if the story pulls itself together in the coming chapters. (I have only read the comic)

name: The Greatest Estate Developer
commentsPratyush: Civil Engineering student isekais into a medieval fantasy novel, and brings them the gift of capitalism. Its as ridiculous as it sounds- and I love it. 10/10 facial expressions.

name: Hunter X Hunter
commentsKanav: Its a good story to pass time but it was not very moving for me, I realy like the art and power system but the story was still a bit short in comparision to others and plot twists were a bit infrequent so I didn't get that thrill of having my expectations subverted often. Its a great story when you read it but it is also forgettable

name: Lookism
length: Ongoing webtoon with 617 episodes, 8 episodes on Netflix
commentsKanav: Drop after killing CEO guy, the story just becomes Baki with diffrent characheters

name: Surviving as a Genius on Borrowed Time
The Terrible Two
commentsPratyush: Funny light read. Wouldn't go out of my way to recommend this though.

name: Reincarnation of the suicidal battlegod
commentsPratyush: Its a real shame they dropped this one. I quite liked the art style and story in this one, even if a lot of the tropes used to build this story have now become overused in the years since it got dropped.

name: Roald Dahl
commentsPratyush: I love Roald Dahl, but I'll probably have to come back and think of the specific books again.

name: Michael Vey
commentsPratyush: Really interesting concept for powers based on actual physics. Starts great, but falls off quite poorly towards the last few books.
commentsKanav: The human aspect of this story is great, it has been a while since I read this but it was nice

name: Player who can’t level up
commentsPratyush: Starts off great, gets confusing in the middle, back to being good. Interesting concept of not being able to level up and relying entirely on your equipment, but it collapses back to - scrap anything I've told you, the protagonist is the chosen one.

name: Villain to Kill
commentsPratyush: I thought this would be bad, but it has been surprisingly okay. I wouldn't go out of my way to recommend this, but not bad.

name: Pick Me Up, Infinite Gacha
commentsPratyush: Very interesting concept, gets annoying towards the end because the author brings in random tropes that feel off-putting. The ending drags this down for me, despite it being a generally enjoyable story for the most part.

name: Doctor’s rebirth
commentsPratyush: Cool concept - a war medic isekai's (reincarnates/transfers) into a murim (chinese martial arts) world.

name: Sleeping Ranker
commentsPratyush: Another VR game, but the protagonist just sleeps a lot and then unlocks a special myth level class that makes him OP. He continues half-playing and half-sleeping.

name: Wimps Strategy Guide to Conquer the Tower
Geronimo Stilton
commentsPratyush: Peak fiction back in primary school. I have probably read over a 100 of these books now.

name: My Hero Academia
commentsPratyush: Do I have issues with the story? Yes. Does the story go from a beautiful set of characters with a lot of potential to just a big 3? Also yes. Do they force unecessary fan service and ships that don't make any sense or matter for the plot? Also yes. But they have one very redeeming point - Bakugo is awesome. That being said, haters might be right that he's a Roy Mustang rip off.
commentsKanav: Eh (Not bad but not a fav)

name: Demon Slayer
commentsPratyush: Very honest name - that's the entire story. The animation and sound production make this a really good watch tho.

name: Solo Max-Level Newbie
commentsPratyush: There are a ton of apocalyptic tower climbing stories that rip off tropes and mythology, but this is one of the best executions of it.

name: Reformation of the Deadbeat Noble
commentsPratyush: The start is very slow and confusing, but if you stick with it - the story gets really good and things start to make sense. Where the manhwa is now, the arc has been a lot of fun to read. Its also a story about locking in - and how much you can improve your life if you do.

name: Naruto + Shippudden
length: 720 episodes, Boruto at 293 (ongoing), Boruto comic at 116 (ongoing), 3 movies
commentsPratyush: The first anime I watched. Loved it when I first watched it - but I analyzed it too much and now I can't unsee the issues I have with the story. Still one of the previous gen big 3 for a reason. I could probably give an impromptu 1 hour lecture on the sharingan.
commentsKanav: Never watched real shipuden, all my information and entertainment is from amagi and other channels that have summary videos

name: Harry Potter
commentsPratyush: People have been telling me I look like Harry Potter since grade 8. I even got round glasses in the middle + I'm the same height as Daniel Radcliff. This unfortunately doesn't stop me from giving the story a B - I love the fandom, but outgrew the story eventually. Also, they really shouldn't have made Snape black in the new show...

name: One Punch Man
commentsPratyush: Look - its a gag story. If you accept that as a premise, its entertaining.
commentsKanav: C is not a bad rating, its just average and meant to be funny, the story is not deep and S3 shot the animators and the hands

name: Revenge of the iron blooded sword hound
commentsPratyush: Its not that special - you've seen this plot before - but its a fun story regardless.

name: Return of the Disaster Class Hero
commentsPratyush: It was great when it started, but then the inconsistent posting schedule, and the slow & unclear progression of the main plot drop it down for me. I still read it, but wouldn't recommend it the same way I did in the start.

name: The Newbie is Too Strong
commentsPratyush: I only read this for the Poppois - the really cute pets of the protagonist.

name: Everyone else is a returnee
commentsPratyush: Tries to flip the trope of a returnee by having one human God forgot about, and accidentally left on earth while everyone else went on a magical adventure. Then some angels try to help him out with some make-shift assistance, but this accidentally makes him stronger than any returnee despite not having magic.

name: All of DragonBall
commentsPratyush: Its a very honest story - people punch each other, over and over again. You know what you sign up for.
commentsKanav: I find that the story feels like every single arc is trying to be endgame which makes previous arcs feel miniscule in comparison
favoriteCharacters: Gohan (so valid for not following in Goku's footsteps)

name: The Tutorial is Too Hard
commentsPratyush: Meh?

name: The World After The End
commentsPratyush: Started off fine, but then they got Jaehwan running around naked so I dropped it.

name: Classroom of the Elite
commentsPratyush: I liked the quotes. It felt smart and cool in the start, and it has its moments. Unfortunately, it collapses into a mainpulation show.
commentsKanav: eh not fun

name: The Game That I Came From
commentsPratyush: One of the many futuristic VR game stories - kind of an Overgeared rip off. I enjoyed reading it in the start, then Kanav and I talked about it, and now I realize its mid.

name: Reincarnation of the strongest Sword God
commentsPratyush: I don't know why I read this. I wasted so many hours of my life on this. The story wasn't even good. Would lowkey read an AI summary of the plot if I picked it up now.
commentsKanav: Just don't

name: Attack on Titan
commentsPratyush: Haven't watched it.
commentsKanav: I believe this is the best story in the whole list. Great at everything though it realy picks up around S3. I could not predict how the story would go at all even with how much I have read, its a must watch.
favoriteCharacters: Reiner, Levi, Erwin Smith, Sasha and Jean

name: The Beginning After the end
commentsPratyush: One of my favorite stories. Great world building, character development, plot progression, and many beautiful quotes. I prefer the books/novels by far. The protagonist is talented, but also relatably human - making internally consistent decisions. Minimal plot armour. Many lessons about responsibility, patience and sacrifice. The only con: Depression.
commentsKanav: Fav Story OAT, Books are better than the manhwa and you should NOT watch the anime. Wish that the ending was a bit diffrent or slower, I might have rushed reading it. 10/10 on everything except the ending which gets a 7/10 (Well above average but compared to the other sections it falls behind)

name: omniscient readers viewpoint
commentsPratyush: I could teach a 10-week college course on this story. This is the singular story I have recommended the most. A lot of my world-view is shaped by it, and people who have read it are able to understand me better. It has like every cliche trope in it - but it does an excellent job of executing it. It has the best execution of any meta-fiction I have seen.

name: Avatar: ATLA
length: 61 Avatar: The Last Airbender episodes, 18 Avatar comics (main post-ATLA comics)
commentsPratyush: Arguably the best animated series I've ever watched. The story, the character development, the world building, the visuals - everything. Don't just think its a kids show - its still a masterpiece all these years later even as an adult.
commentsKanav: Only ATLA - Despite being a childrens show it manages to be deep and interesting, I wish that the ending was slightly diffrent as it feels like the writer was just trying to wrap stuf up

name: Jujutsu Kaisen
commentsPratyush: I'll be really surprised if you don't know about this story. Gege really cooked with this.
commentsKanav: Peak of modern anime, great story and animation, though the reading comprehension of the greater fanbase is questionable, peak memes as well

name: The Potato War
commentsPratyush: Technoblade's cinematic masterpiece. I don't care if you don't watch minecraft videos, this is a life-changing documentary of a man on a mission.

name: Eternally Regressing Knight
length: 112 + prologue (S1 complete at 112) On hiatus between seasons (S2 TBA)

name: Return of the Mount Hua sect
commentsPratyush: This is one of my favorite Murim stories. Chung Myung is hillarious, the drawings are fun, but its antics that really sell me on this story.

name: Star-Embracing Sword Master
commentsPratyush: This is my favorite execution of genius kid (common trope) works really hard and climbs the social heirarchy (common trope) - now in a western medieval knight setting (common trope).

name: Overgeared
commentsPratyush: Its hilarious. Read the novel if you have the time. Bonus if you like video game equipment.
commentsKanav: This was the first Virtual Reality MMORPG story I read so it is speacial to me, I think both the comic and novel are great, its especially fun if you like games

name: Mistborn
commentsPratyush: Really interesting power system where people consume and burn metals and their alloys for very specific powers. Very good world-building and descriptive writing. Brandon Sanderson writes beautifully - so even if you see the twists coming a mile away, the execution is very fun to read.
commentsKanav: 3 very well put together books with 1 novella that you should read if you plan on reading other Cosmere Stories. Ending of book 1 seemed a bit confusing to me but apart from that the story is great

name: Death Note
commentsPratyush: This is a very common recommendation, so most anime watchers have already seen this. What I will point you to is the fan-made remakes and fan-fics that are genuinely hillarious. You can find a lot of them on youtube.
